policy.auto_ack_scope: ACKNOWLEDGED means the receiver intake worker has read and bound the route at an exact AI Core revision. It is not substantive acceptance.
policy.no_auto_review: Workers may not create REVIEWING state without explicit session review evidence.
policy.no_auto_decision: Workers may never create DECIDED state or choose ADOPTED/HOLD/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED automatically.
policy.reconciliation: After mechanical ACK, the worker reconciles A central Routing Receipt from SENT to RECEIVED using the same revision-bound acknowledgement.
